quality_effect: Prevents indicative INSPIRE geometry, reprojection error, or general-boundary semantics from being promoted to exact parcel boundary evidence.

official_sources.title: Practice guide 40 supplement 4: boundary agreements and determined boundaries

official_facts: INSPIRE polygons show indicative extent and position, not exact legal boundary.
INSPIRE data is split by local authority.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary can appear in both files.
Each INSPIRE polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title.
INSPIRE files are GML and updated on the first Sunday of each month.
The July 2026 INSPIRE release was published on 5 July 2026.
HM Land Registry GML geometry is captured against British National Grid.
Reprojection to other coordinate systems can introduce positional error; HMLR warns shifts of up to 15 metres can occur in some BNG-to-WGS84 conversions.
A determined boundary, unlike a general boundary, is used to show the exact line for register purposes.
Determined-boundary measurement plans require measurements accurate to +/-10mm.
National Grid coordinates on determined-boundary plans require absolute accuracy +/-300mm and relative accuracy +/-10mm.
Form DB is used to apply for a boundary to be shown in the register as a determined boundary.
